subject: CPPB Domain III: Sourcing & Supplier Selection

questions.q: Prior to formal RFP negotiations, the evaluation committee meets with the top-ranked vendor solely to ask questions to understand their cost buildup and methodology, without asking for any price reductions or concessions. This phase is formally known as:
questions.explain: Fact-finding is an information-gathering stage where the buyer clarifies uncertainties regarding the vendor's cost or technical proposal to prepare effectively for the actual negotiation phase.
